messages.subject_clean: How to change the loss aversion in igt_vpp
messages.body_plain:
Hi,

you might need to change the stan file if you would like to modify the model.
do save it as a new file, and then call it externally.

hope it helps,

> I wanted to change these parameters. For example, remove loss aversion.

messages.subject: Re: robustness of the estimated parameter
messages.body_plain:
Hi,

I wouldn't imagine over-fitting will happen when you have more trials. In fact, more trials will make model estimation more reliable.
For robustness, you may want to do a parameter recovery analysis.

hope that helps,
Lei

messages.subject: Between-group comparisons
messages.body_plain:
Hi,

I have fitted a model with data which may belong to two different groups.
If I were to fit two different models, group comparisons between parameters would be straightforward (same as here https://ccs-lab.github.io/hBayesDM/articles/getting_started.html#compare-models-and-groups).
Since I only have one model, what would be the correct way to test for group differences?
Selecting the samples belonging to the two different groups and compare them?

Thanks for your help!
Filippo
